capture.description: Images are the complete model-card review screenshots emitted by the unchanged production browser_check.js while traversing the actual course app. Cases unlock at the real lesson step; this is not the maxStep999 focused fixture.

methodology.deduplication: Only identical SHA256 of complete original full-context PNG files, with all aliases retained. No perceptual equivalence, cropped-region equivalence or similarity of geometry was used.
methodology.method: The reviewer viewed every complete contact sheet at original resolution. Original screenshots are pasted at full size without cropping or scaling. Inspected all cards for readable and correctly associated point labels, complete geometry, marker/label separation, clipping, case-button readability and real unlock/active states, auxiliary-construction chronology and special-case notes. The PNG roster and hashes were checked again after review.

limitations: This review covers complete model-card screenshots, not every full lesson page.
No new source-PDF review is claimed; source preparation and math checks are bound by earlier independent reviews.
